newsitem.title: USA: General Mills FY97 international sales up.
newsitem.headline: General Mills FY97 international sales up.

text.p: General Mills Inc said Thursday sales for its international operations, including its share of joint venture sales, grew four percent to $1.0 billion in fiscal 1997.
International unit volume rose seven percent.
Canadian operations posted a 10 percent volume gain and recorded share increases in most major categories including cereals, where share grew two points to exceed 16 percent.
Unit volume grew 17 percent for Cereal Partners Worldwide, the company's cereal joint venture with Nestle SA, and annual sales reached nearly $700 million.

Sales for Snack Ventures Europe, the joint venture with PepsiCo, totaled $900 million and unit volume declined six percent from strong prior-year levels that included heavy promotional activity in key markets.

The International Dessert Partners joint venture in Latin America with CPC International Inc completed its first year of operations and expanded beyond its four initial markets to Uruguay, Chile and Peru.
Total international earnings were below the prior year's, primarily due to development spending for the dessert venture and volume declines in Snack Venture Europe's key markets.
